name: Eritrea
headline: Eritrea: +3.8% growth in 2019, 1.3% inflation, debt 260% of GDP
sections: Eritrea is a $2.0 billion economy (2019), the world's 194th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.8% in 2019, close to the world median of +3.5%.
Consumer prices rose 1.3% in 2019, broadly within typical target ranges, up from −5.6% in 2016. Unemployment stood at 6.0% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 10.2% (2025).
Gross government debt is 260% of GDP (2019), a very high level that has risen from 205% in 2014. The general government balance is +2.7% of GDP (2019), a surplus.
The current account balance is +13.0% of GDP (2019), a large surplus.
Life expectancy is 68.9 years (2024). Population: 3.6 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
